rca of the issue: 1) db.invoice_edits missing → _DB class in database.py enumerates every allowed collection explicitly (no __getattr__ fallback). Adding `invoice_edits = TenantCollection(_raw_db.invoice_edits)` resolves. 2) edit_count key absent in response → route returned {**inv, **updates}; edit_count only mutated via $inc (not in updates dict) and inv was fetched before mutation. Fixed by injecting updates['edit_count'] = old+1 after update_one.
